channel.title: World Over
channel.desc: Robert Royal and Fr. Gerald Murray recap last week's Consistory of Cardinals in Rome, including Cardinal Zen's interventions critical of "synodality". Nina Shea updates us on the "mitigation hearings" for Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong. Author Carrie Gress talks about her new book, Something Wicked: Why Feminism Can't be Fused with Christianity. (60 minutes).
